grades.quote: `SC.Q` instruction will check LLbit when executing, and only when LLbit is 1, then it will write, otherwise it will not write, `SC.Q` instruction will write the flag of success or failure (also can be understood as the value of LLbit when `SC.Q` instruction executes) into general register rd and return to the memory.
grades.reason: Explains LLbit-based conditional writing and returned success status for SC.Q, providing useful related semantics but not specifically SC.W or why LLbit changes after LL.W.
